release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Adds local action timing telemetry: wall and worker CPU seconds, batch/row counts and worker PID in action results, a completion summary in Action status, and a private latest timings.json in persistent state. No external telemetry, credentials or paths are recorded. Builds the temporary catalogue lookup index once after loading; uses a bounded 32 MiB temporary SQLite page cache while retaining disk-backed tables and persistent durability. Uses symlink-skipping directory-entry discovery, avoids non-candidate preview existence checks, and skips provider-show selection when no generated episodes are tracked. Complete catalogue/M3U absence and verified deletion rules remain intact. Live measured preview improved from 87 to 31 seconds with zero errors/warnings: complete 627,500-row catalogue 19 seconds, discovery 9.6 seconds, Emby 2.2 seconds, preview checks 0.4 seconds. Explicit names/IDs, normalization, cancellation/deadlines and native categories retained. Validation: 299 local tests passed with four Windows platform skips; publisher/package checks passed.
